fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/deep-hole-recreation-area ('$15 per site/night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10075391/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: StandardNonelectric $15), read 2026-10-29

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/deep-hole-recreation-area ('The Interagency Senior and Access Passes and the Golden Age and Access Passports are accepted. These passes entitle the pass holder to a 50% discount for single family campsites.'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10075391 ('There is no water, hook-ups, elecricity, or dump station'; all 9 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 9 sites in one loop. Only sites 3 and 9 list an RV, to 30 ft (site 9 is the one pull-through); sites 5 and 6 list RVs to 20 ft, and the rest take camper vans of 15-20 ft and tents.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A10075391 (permitted equipment per site: RV max_length 30 at sites 3 and 9, 20 at 5 and 6, none at 1, 2, 4, 7, 8; site 9 'Pull-through', the rest back-in), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10075391 ('Deep Hole has one double vault toilet within the campground', 'There is no drinking water, electrical hook-ups, or dump-station service at this site') + FS page ('Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: Reservations required: 'You may reserve camp sites the same day as you arrive and as far as six (6) months in advance. However, reservations cannot be made on-site.' Self-service campground.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/deep-hole-recreation-area ('Reservations are required to camp in this campground', 'same day as you arrive and as far as six (6) months in advance') + recreation.gov notice ('visitors are invited to occupy campsites with a qualified reservation'), read 2026-10-29

status.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/chattahoochee-oconee/recreation/deep-hole-recreation-area ('Site Open'; no closure among the alerts), read 2026-10-29

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Blue Ridge Ranger District, on the Toccoa River south of Blue Ridge off GA Hwy 60. Sites 5 and 9 sit beside the river. Put-in for the 13.8-mile Toccoa River Canoe Trail. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: $15 (2026/2027), reservations required up to 6 months out, Senior/Access 50%, no hookups/water/dump, vault toilet; 9 sites, but only sites 3 and 9 take an RV (30 ft; 9 is a pull-through, so pull_through false -> true). Status open. Phone 706-745-6928 (Blue Ridge RD) matches rec.gov. Pin is within ~40 m of the site centroid. Note trimmed of hookups/fees/booking/length facts.
flags: Only 2 of 9 sites take a 23-ft motorhome: recreation.gov's per-site equipment lists RV up to 30 ft at sites 3 and 9 only (sites 5 and 6: RV 20 ft; the other five: camper van 15-20 ft, no RV). The campground qualifies, but availability for EKKO is two sites.
